cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Dad, I've accepted the museum job. Can you be pleased I'm leaving the workshop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're thirty. You don't need me to release you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I need the person who taught me to make things to think this counts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pack your tools. You might want to come back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sharpen them for the museum instead? Send me off expecting me to do well.

mechanism: A treats its former craft pupil as still needing correction even while needing that pupil emotional approval for A own new job.
confusable: Not actual permission or mere tool help: A wants the pupil to expect success in the new role.
comparison: Former teacher seeking pupil blessing versus adult child coaching parental welcome.
seedUse: D76 museum/workshop/tools retained with roles explicitly changed so A is the teacher.
